2024-03-21.headline: The U.S. sues Apple, saying it abuses its power to monopolize the smartphone market
2024-03-21.summary: The Justice Department, along with 15 states and D.C., has filed a major antitrust lawsuit against Apple, accusing the tech giant of abusing its monopoly power in the smartphone market. The lawsuit alleges that Apple restricts access to its hardware and software, designs features like iMessage and Apple Pay to lock users into its ecosystem, and suppresses competition, leading to fewer options and higher prices for consumers. Apple denies these claims, stating that its restrictions protect user privacy and security, and vows to vigorously defend itself against the suit.

2024-03-12.headline: Apple v. Rivos: Lessons for Companies Facing Claims of Trade Secret Theft (US)
2024-03-12.summary: This article discusses the lessons learned from the Apple v. Rivos case regarding trade secret theft. The ruling provides key takeaways for companies to guide their trade secret policies and practices to avoid litigation.
